description: Build credential proxy module in agent-api that stores encrypted user API keys, returns capability lists to the agent, and proxies external API calls so the agent never sees raw credentials.

context.currentProblem: Users cannot connect external services (Shopify, Mailchimp, etc.) to Vibey. The agent has no way to make authenticated external API calls on behalf of users.
context.desiredState: Users add API keys via settings UI. Keys are encrypted in DB (AES-256). Agent sees a capability list only ('Shopify: read_products'). Agent requests actions via vibey_backend tool. Backend decrypts key, makes the API call, returns result. Agent never sees raw keys. All usage is logged in audit trail.
context.architectureGoal: New NestJS module: apps/agent-api/src/modules/credentials/. Controller + Service + DTOs. Encryption via Node.js crypto (AES-256-GCM). ENCRYPTION_KEY from env var. Follows 3-layer architecture from backend guidelines.

userStories.title: Create credentials DB table with encryption
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a credentials table in Supabase that stores encrypted API keys with capability metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration creates 'credentials' table with columns: id (UUID PK), user_id (UUID FK), service_name (TEXT), encrypted_value (TEXT — base64 encoded AES-256-GCM), capabilities (TEXT[]), revoked (BOOLEAN DEFAULT false), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ)
Migration creates 'credential_usage' audit table with columns: id (UUID PK), credential_id (UUID FK), agent_id (TEXT), action (TEXT), params (JSONB), response_status (INT), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ)
RLS policies on both tables: users can only see their own credentials
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Use Supabase MCP apply_migration tool. Schema from PRD section 9.1.

userStories.title: Build credentials NestJS module with encryption service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a NestJS module that encrypts/decrypts credentials using AES-256-GCM and provides CRUD operations.
acceptanceCriteria: New module at apps/agent-api/src/modules/credentials/ with controllers/, services/, dtos/
credentials.module.ts registered in app.module.ts
Encryption uses Node.js crypto: AES-256-GCM with random IV per credential
ENCRYPTION_KEY read from env var (32-byte key, base64 encoded)
encrypt(plaintext) returns base64 string (IV + ciphertext + auth tag)
decrypt(encrypted) returns original plaintext
Service file under 600 LOC, controller under 200 LOC
Zod validation on all inputs
LoggerService for error logging
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Follow backend-architecture.md 3-layer pattern. Use InternalAuthGuard for agent endpoints, AuthGuard for user endpoints.

userStories.title: Build GET /api/capabilities endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an endpoint that returns available integrations and their capabilities for the current user (called by agent via vibey_backend tool).
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/capabilities returns { capabilities: [{ service: 'shopify', actions: ['read_products'] }] }
Only returns non-revoked credentials
Never returns the actual encrypted key — only service name + capabilities array
Uses InternalAuthGuard (agent requests) and reads USER_ID from env
Returns empty array if no credentials exist
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: This replaces the stubbed get_capabilities action in artifacts.service.ts

userStories.title: Build POST /api/integrations/execute proxy endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an endpoint that decrypts a credential, makes an external API call on behalf of the user, and returns the result.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/integrations/execute accepts { service: string, action: string, params: object }
Looks up credential by service_name + user_id where revoked=false
Decrypts the API key using AES-256-GCM
Makes the external API call using the decrypted key
Logs usage in credential_usage table (credential_id, action, params sanitized, response_status)
Returns the API response data to the agent — NOT the raw key
If credential not found: returns { success: false, error: 'Integration not available' }
If credential revoked: returns { success: false, error: 'Integration is disabled' }
Rate limited: 10 requests per minute per user
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: This replaces the stubbed use_integration action in artifacts.service.ts. Start with Shopify as first supported integration.

userStories.title: Build user-facing credential management endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need endpoints for users to add, list, and revoke their API credentials from the settings UI.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/credentials — add new credential (encrypts and stores)
GET /api/credentials — list user's credentials (returns service_name, capabilities, revoked — NEVER the key)
DELETE /api/credentials/:id — revoke credential (sets revoked=true, does NOT delete)
Uses AuthGuard (user JWT authentication, not internal agent auth)
Zod validation on all inputs
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: These are called from the frontend settings UI, not from the agent.
